title: Common providers: United Kingdom
coverage: Complete for the national fixed-line carriers, the four mobile network operators and the main wholesale access networks; business ISPs and full-fibre alternative networks are partial (the largest by reach only).
missing: AS numbers for Openreach, CityFibre and Neos Networks (none confirmed)

sources.name: Ofcom: Connected Nations
sources.terms: Ofcom's copyright page allows reproduction free of charge with acknowledgement; the report itself is in documents that were not parsed.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: List of broadband providers in the United Kingdom
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 14 of 23 candidate names were found on the page.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in the United Kingdom
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 16 of 23 candidate names were found on the page.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 21 of 22 websites and 5 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 20 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company was removed.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: BT
providers.notes: Trades as BT Business for business lines; network identity BTnet.

providers.name: Openreach
providers.notes: Wholesale access network; lines are sold through retail providers, so it is seldom the name on the bill.

providers.name: Sky
providers.notes: Sky Business sells leased lines and broadband.

providers.name: TalkTalk
providers.notes: TalkTalk Business; wholesale arm trades as PXC.

providers.name: Vodafone UK
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile; AS1273 is the international backbone.

providers.name: EE
providers.notes: Mobile operator of the BT group; 4G/5G backup and fixed wireless.

providers.name: Three UK
providers.notes: Mobile operator; merged with Vodafone UK in 2025 (VodafoneThree).

providers.name: O2
providers.notes: Mobile operator of Virgin Media O2.

providers.name: KCOM
providers.notes: Incumbent in Hull and East Yorkshire.

providers.name: Colt Technology Services
providers.notes: Business fibre and Ethernet in city centres.

providers.name: Neos Networks
providers.notes: Business and wholesale fibre; formerly SSE Enterprise Telecoms.

providers.name: PXC
providers.notes: Wholesale only; formerly TalkTalk Wholesale Services and Virtual1.

providers.name: Starlink
providers.notes: Satellite; common as a backup line at rural sites.
